scope: Full existing CSharp codegen key domain and part ordering: module, synthetic, whole interface/implementation, prefix/suffix. Native key metadata discovery and production cache consumption remain pending.
decisions: Preserve all current field strings, domain tags, input order, source-byte/interface/dependency/type-universe/emission inputs and hashes.
Move the nine key layouts to compiled typed CSharp rules. CSharp consumes those rules directly and SLG receives generated domain strings and typed part sequences.
Representation-specific adapters must provide requested fields; missing or unknown parts throw instead of inventing values.
Keep Native production cache integration at1/3 until actual current metadata, lookup/consumption and post-link publication pass.
hexFormat: CSharp Hex uses lowercase invariant x16; adapters must preserve exactly16 lowercase hexadecimal bytes.
